title: anthemis parnassica
intro: Anthemis parnassica, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a perennial plant species belonging to the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis parnassica include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation due to its sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
